pareto.name: Pareto (Power-Law) - UPI / Micropayments
pareto.description: 80% of transactions are low-value micro-payments under 500 INR, with heavy long tail for occasional large payments.

lognormal.name: Log-Normal - Retail & Card Spending
lognormal.description: Right-skewed multiplicative distribution typical of merchant POS and debit card retail spending.

gaussian.name: Gaussian (Normal) - Scheduled & ATM Transfers
gaussian.description: Bell-curve centered around regular utility bills and standard round ATM cash withdrawals.

uniform.name: Uniform Random (Baseline Model)
uniform.description: Flat probability density used in naive baseline generators.
